meta.direction: Redesigned to the user's reference image (black ground, sticker accents, green progress). Old cosmic-violet values are recorded in ux-audit.md.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The ground of every screen: true black. Never put a card colour here; depth comes from surfaces on top of it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, widgets, grouped lists, the calendar, sheets and dialogs. One step above bg.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inputs, secondary buttons, chips, icon buttons, pressed rows. Also raised cards inside a surface.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Tracks (progress bars, rings, empty dots, switches off), skeleton highlights, the sheet grabber. Never a text ground.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The 1px top highlight on cards and the divider between rows. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outline of an unchecked habit check and any outlined control: 4.1:1 on surface, 5.1:1 on bg.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-2 and accent-surface. Also the selected chip/segment fill.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, body copy in cards, timestamps. 6.6:1 on surface, 5.4:1 on surface-2.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: section labels, metadata, completed (struck-through) habits, inactive tab labels. 5.2:1 on surface, 6.4:1 on bg; on surface-2 it drops to 4.3:1, so use text-2 there. Not on accent-surface either (4.3–5.0:1 depending on theme): text-2 there.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and future calendar days only. Below 4.5:1 on purpose (WCAG exempts disabled controls); never for content.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE progress colour, swapped by the Appearance theme: checked habits, filled dots, ring arcs, perfect days, the active tab pip, links. Text in accent reads on bg, surface and accent-surface in every theme (≥5:1). Crimson theme: accent sits next to danger-text in hue, so missed/error states there must keep their icon and word.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of accent-filled buttons.

tokens.name: accent-surface
tokens.usage: Dark accent tint: the streak band behind runs of perfect calendar days, accent badges, the accent-tint card. Text and accent both read on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (check glyphs, accent buttons). Black on every theme's accent is ≥7:1; white would fail on all of them.

tokens.name: btn-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: one per screen, the action the screen exists for.

tokens.name: btn-primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button while pressed.

tokens.name: on-btn-primary
tokens.usage: Label on the primary button.

tokens.name: streak
tokens.usage: Streaks and fire only: the STREAK pill, streak counts, the streak bar. Orange is never used for errors.

tokens.name: streak-surface
tokens.usage: Quiet streak pill ground (a streak count inside a list row).

tokens.name: on-streak
tokens.usage: Text on a streak fill. 10.2:1.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Coins, XP rewards, the boss and achievements. Text in gold reads on every surface (≥9.8:1).

tokens.name: gold-surface
tokens.usage: Ground for gold badges and the boss card when the boss is defeated.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive fills and error borders (input error, missed-day ring).

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error and destructive text/icons: 6.0:1 on surface, 4.9:1 on surface-2 (danger itself is 4.1 there).

tokens.name: danger-surface
tokens.usage: Ground of destructive buttons, error banners and missed calendar days.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational accents that must not read as progress: Focus session labels, AI notes, the season counter.

tokens.name: sticker-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the count sticker (2/5) and stamp labels.

tokens.name: sticker-ink
tokens.usage: Outline and text stroke of stickers and the speech-bubble border/text.

tokens.name: sticker-outline
tokens.usage: The thick white die-cut edge around companion stickers and the big STREAK pill.

tokens.name: bubble
tokens.usage: Speech-bubble fill. The companion is the only thing that speaks in a bubble.

tokens.name: bubble-ink
tokens.usage: Speech-bubble text and outline. 21:1.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Floating glass only (notification cards, live activity, the reminder toast): blue-grey at 80% over a 24px blur. Never for static cards.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Top inner highlight on glass.

tokens.name: nav-bg
tokens.usage: Tab bar background over a 24px blur.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every control. 21:1 on bg, 17:1 on surface; on the white primary button the offset gap shows it.

tokens.name: rarity-common
tokens.usage: Common habits (×1 XP). Dot + label. Always paired with the rarity word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: rarity-rare
tokens.usage: Rare habits (×1.5). 6.0:1 on surface. Always paired with the rarity word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: rarity-epic
tokens.usage: Epic habits (×2). Always paired with the rarity word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: rarity-legendary
tokens.usage: Legendary habits (×3). Always paired with the rarity word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: rarity-mythic
tokens.usage: Mythic habits (×5). Always paired with the rarity word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: victory-elite
tokens.usage: Victory score 90+ (Elite). Shown with the tier word next to the number.

tokens.name: victory-great
tokens.usage: Victory score 75–89. Shown with the tier word next to the number.

tokens.name: victory-good
tokens.usage: Victory score 60–74. Shown with the tier word next to the number.

tokens.name: victory-fair
tokens.usage: Victory score 50–59. Shown with the tier word next to the number.

tokens.name: victory-low
tokens.usage: Victory score under 50. Shown with the tier word next to the number.

tokens.name: showcase-ground
tokens.usage: Design-system pages only: the light presentation ground behind phone mockups. Not used in the app.

tokens.name: showcase-bezel
tokens.usage: Design-system pages only: phone mockup bezel.

tokens.name: showcase-ink
tokens.usage: Design-system pages only: captions on showcase-ground.

tokens.name: showcase-ink-2
tokens.usage: Design-system pages only: secondary captions on showcase-ground (5.5:1).

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", -apple-system, "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Onboarding and moment headlines (Level up, Welcome). One per screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Tab screen titles: Today, Focus, Progress, Friends, You.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Push-screen titles in the back bar, notification sender.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Habit titles (600), row titles (600), paragraph text.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Secondary copy in cards, chips (600), bubbles (700).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under a title: rarity, reminder time, row subtitles.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Section labels in text-3, uppercase: THE FIVE, DAILY QUESTS.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Tab labels and calendar weekday heads. Nothing smaller exists.

styles.name: numeral-xl
styles.usage: The focus timer and the level-up number. Tabular figures.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat tiles and ring centres. Tabular figures.

styles.name: sticker
styles.usage: The count sticker (3/5) in sticker-fill with a sticker-ink stroke, rotated -4°.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Title-to-subtitle gap inside a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in pills; label inset.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between chips, between a section label and its card, button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Widget grid gap; check-to-title gap; between stacked cards in a group.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding; the gap between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Screen gutter (left/right) on phones; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Before a primary button block; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between a hero and the content below on onboarding and moments.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Top air above display-xl headlines on full-screen moments.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Calendar day highlight inner corners, tiny badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Row icon tiles, pressed rows, calendar streak band ends.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, widgets, grouped lists, glass notifications, the calendar.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets (top corners) and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, pills, segmented controls, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only things that float: sheets, dialogs, toasts, glass notifications, the FAB. Cards have no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: The hard offset under stickers, bubbles and the big STREAK pill — the cut-out paper look.
